   472	noncomputable def AffineCoverMVSquare.hModuleOneEquivH1Cokₗ_unit
   473	    (S : C.left.AffineCoverMVSquare) :

   476	  S.hModuleOneEquivH1Cok_curve.trans (S.unitH1CokₗEquiv C).symm

   481	theorem AffineCoverMVSquare.h1_unit_eq_genus [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom]
   482	    [IsProper C.hom] [GeometricallyIntegral C.hom] (S : C.left.AffineCoverMVSquare) :
   483	    S.h1 C (SheafOfModules.unit C.left.ringCatSheaf) = genus C :=

   486	/-- The structure ring map at the top open is the global-sections structure map
   487	`constMap` of `Picard/SectionRingUniversal.lean`: the restriction along
   488	`⊤ ≤ ⊤` is the identity (`map_id`, applied pointwise — `kToSection (op ⊤)` is
   489	definitionally `constMap` followed by the restriction along `𝟙 (op ⊤)`). -/
   490	lemma kToSection_top_apply (c : k) :
   491	    (toModuleKSheaf.kToSection C (Opposite.op (⊤ : C.left.Opens))).hom c =
   492	      (constMap C).hom c :=
   493	  congrArg (fun g => CommRingCat.Hom.hom g ((constMap C).hom c))
   494	    (C.left.presheaf.map_id (Opposite.op (⊤ : C.left.Opens)))
   495	
   496	/-- **`Γ(C, 𝒪_C) = k` in `BaseSections` form**: the unconditional
   497	field-of-constants theorem `globalSectionsAlgEquivBase`
   498	(`Picard/SectionRingUniversal.lean`, `HasTrivialConstants` discharged
   499	unconditionally via H⁰ flat base change) as a `k`-linear equivalence
   500	`BaseSections C 𝒪 ⊤ ≃ₗ[k] k` — the `BaseSections` scalar path at `⊤` is the
   501	`constMap` scalar path (`kToSection_top_apply`). -/
   502	noncomputable def unitTopSectionsEquivBase [IsProper C.hom] [GeometricallyIntegral C.hom] :
   503	    BaseSections C (SheafOfModules.unit C.left.ringCatSheaf) (⊤ : C.left.Opens) ≃ₗ[k] k where
   504	  toFun x := globalSectionsAlgEquivBase C (x : Γ(C.left, ⊤))
   505	  invFun c := ((globalSectionsAlgEquivBase C).symm c : Γ(C.left, ⊤))
   506	  map_add' x y := map_add (globalSectionsAlgEquivBase C) x y
   507	  map_smul' c x := by
   508	    have hb : baseRingMap C (⊤ : C.left.Opens) c = (constMap C).hom c :=
   509	      kToSection_top_apply C c
   510	    change globalSectionsAlgEquivBase C
   511	        (baseRingMap C (⊤ : C.left.Opens) c • BaseSections.val x) =
   512	      c • globalSectionsAlgEquivBase C (BaseSections.val x)
   513	    rw [hb]
   514	    exact (globalSectionsAlgEquivBase C).toLinearEquiv.map_smul c (BaseSections.val x)
   515	  left_inv x := (globalSectionsAlgEquivBase C).symm_apply_apply x
   516	  right_inv c := (globalSectionsAlgEquivBase C).apply_symm_apply c
   517	
   518	/-- **`h⁰(𝒪_C) = 1`** — on every 2-affine cover, over every field: the kernel
   519	of the difference map is the global sections (`globalSectionsEquivH0ₗ`), which
   520	are exactly the constants `k` (`unitTopSectionsEquivBase`). -/
   521	theorem AffineCoverMVSquare.h0_unit_eq_one [IsProper C.hom] [GeometricallyIntegral C.hom]
   522	    (S : C.left.AffineCoverMVSquare) :
   523	    S.h0 C (SheafOfModules.unit C.left.ringCatSheaf) = 1 := by

   527	  change Module.finrank k (S.H0ₗ C (SheafOfModules.unit C.left.ringCatSheaf)) = 1
   528	  rw [e.finrank_eq, Module.finrank_self]

   530	/-- **`χ(𝒪_C) = 1 − g` — the first honest entry of the P3 `χ`-ledger.**  On

   532	theorem AffineCoverMVSquare.chi_unit_eq_one_sub_genus [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom]

   549	    [IsProper C.hom] [GeometricallyIntegral C.hom] (S : C.left.AffineCoverMVSquare) :

210	/-- The `k`-linear difference map has the same underlying function as the
   211	`AddMonoidHom`-level `moduleSectionDiff`; this is what transports every
   212	statement about the additive kit to the `k`-linear kit and back. -/
   213	lemma AffineCoverMVSquare.sectionDiffₗ_coe_moduleSectionDiff
   214	    (S : C.left.AffineCoverMVSquare) (M : C.left.Modules) :
   215	    ⇑(S.sectionDiffₗ C M) = ⇑(S.moduleSectionDiff M) :=
   216	  rfl
   217	
   218	/-- **`H⁰` on the cover, as a submodule**: the kernel of the `k`-linear
   219	difference map — pairs of sections agreeing on the overlap.  By the sheaf
   220	condition this is the global sections (`globalSectionsEquivH0ₗ`), which is
   221	why `h0` is honestly cover-independent already at this wave. -/
   222	noncomputable def AffineCoverMVSquare.H0ₗ (S : C.left.AffineCoverMVSquare)
   223	    (M : C.left.Modules) :
   224	    Submodule k (BaseSections C M S.U₁ × BaseSections C M S.U₂) :=
   225	  LinearMap.ker (S.sectionDiffₗ C M)
   226	
   227	/-- **The concrete Čech `Ȟ¹` of the cover, as a `k`-module**: the cokernel
   228	`Γ(U₁ ⊓ U₂, M) ⧸ im(sectionDiffₗ)`.  Same underlying abelian group as
   229	`AffineCoverMVSquare.moduleH1Cok` (the ranges of `sectionDiffₗ` and
   230	`moduleSectionDiff` coincide, `sectionDiffₗ_coe_moduleSectionDiff`). -/
   231	noncomputable def AffineCoverMVSquare.H1Cokₗ (S : C.left.AffineCoverMVSquare)
   232	    (M : C.left.Modules) : Type u :=
   233	  BaseSections C M (S.U₁ ⊓ S.U₂) ⧸ LinearMap.range (S.sectionDiffₗ C M)
   234	
   235	noncomputable instance (S : C.left.AffineCoverMVSquare) (M : C.left.Modules) :
   236	    AddCommGroup (S.H1Cokₗ C M) :=
   237	  inferInstanceAs (AddCommGroup (_ ⧸ LinearMap.range (S.sectionDiffₗ C M)))
   238	
   239	noncomputable instance (S : C.left.AffineCoverMVSquare) (M : C.left.Modules) :
   240	    Module k (S.H1Cokₗ C M) :=
   241	  inferInstanceAs (Module k (_ ⧸ LinearMap.range (S.sectionDiffₗ C M)))
   242	
   243	/-- **`h⁰(M)` on the cover `S`**: the `k`-dimension of the kernel of the
   244	difference map (junk value `0` when infinite-dimensional; finiteness for
   245	general coherent `M` is a later P2 wave). -/
   246	noncomputable def AffineCoverMVSquare.h0 (S : C.left.AffineCoverMVSquare)
   247	    (M : C.left.Modules) : ℕ :=
   248	  Module.finrank k (S.H0ₗ C M)
   249	
   250	/-- **`h¹(M)` on the cover `S`**: the `k`-dimension of the concrete Čech
   251	cokernel (junk value `0` when infinite-dimensional). -/
   252	noncomputable def AffineCoverMVSquare.h1 (S : C.left.AffineCoverMVSquare)
   253	    (M : C.left.Modules) : ℕ :=
   254	  Module.finrank k (S.H1Cokₗ C M)
   255	
   256	/-- **The Euler characteristic `χ(M) = h⁰(M) − h¹(M)` on the cover `S`.**
   257	It agrees with the sheaf-theoretic `χ` whenever both `h⁰` and `h¹` are finite
   258	and the cover computes them, which for the curves considered here is every
   259	2-affine cover. -/
   260	noncomputable def AffineCoverMVSquare.chi (S : C.left.AffineCoverMVSquare)
   261	    (M : C.left.Modules) : ℤ :=
   262	  (S.h0 C M : ℤ) - (S.h1 C M : ℤ)
   263	
   264	lemma AffineCoverMVSquare.chi_def (S : C.left.AffineCoverMVSquare)
   265	    (M : C.left.Modules) :
   266	    S.chi C M = (S.h0 C M : ℤ) - (S.h1 C M : ℤ) :=
   267	  rfl

   159	/-- The restriction map `Γ(M, U) → Γ(M, V)` (`V ≤ U`) of a sheaf of modules is

   163	noncomputable def BaseSections.restrictₗ (C : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)))
   164	    (M : C.left.Modules) {U V : C.left.Opens} (h : V ≤ U) :

   181	/-! ## §2. The `k`-linear Čech kit on a 2-affine cover: `H⁰ₗ`, `Ȟ¹ₗ`, `h⁰`, `h¹`, `χ` -/
   182	
   183	section CechKit
   184	
   185	variable {k : Type u} [CommRing k]
   186	variable (C : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)))
   187	
   188	/-- **The difference-of-restrictions map, `k`-linear form**: the base-ring
   189	linear upgrade of `AffineCoverMVSquare.moduleSectionDiff`
   190	(`Picard/RigidPushforward.lean`) for a sheaf of modules `M` on a `k`-scheme
   191	`C`:
   192	`Γ(U₁, M) × Γ(U₂, M) →ₗ[k] Γ(U₁ ⊓ U₂, M)`, `(a, b) ↦ a|₁₂ − b|₁₂`.
   193	Same underlying function as `moduleSectionDiff`
   194	(`sectionDiffₗ_coe_moduleSectionDiff`). -/
   195	noncomputable def AffineCoverMVSquare.sectionDiffₗ (S : C.left.AffineCoverMVSquare)
   196	    (M : C.left.Modules) :
   197	    BaseSections C M S.U₁ × BaseSections C M S.U₂ →ₗ[k]
   198	      BaseSections C M (S.U₁ ⊓ S.U₂) :=
   199	  (BaseSections.restrictₗ C M inf_le_left).comp (LinearMap.fst k _ _) -
   200	    (BaseSections.restrictₗ C M inf_le_right).comp (LinearMap.snd k _ _)
   201	
   202	/-- The value of the `k`-linear difference map. -/
   203	lemma AffineCoverMVSquare.sectionDiffₗ_apply (S : C.left.AffineCoverMVSquare)
   204	    (M : C.left.Modules) (p : BaseSections C M S.U₁ × BaseSections C M S.U₂) :
   205	    S.sectionDiffₗ C M p =
   206	      (M.presheaf.map (homOfLE (inf_le_left : S.U₁ ⊓ S.U₂ ≤ S.U₁)).op).hom p.1 -
   207	        (M.presheaf.map (homOfLE (inf_le_right : S.U₁ ⊓ S.U₂ ≤ S.U₂)).op).hom p.2 :=
   208	  rfl

140	/-- **The section restrictions of `M` are `Γ(S, ⊤)`-linear** for the
   141	`baseSectionsModule` structures: the presheaf restriction is semilinear over
   142	the restriction of `𝒪_X` (`Scheme.Modules.map_smul`), and the two `appLE`
   143	composites agree (`Scheme.Hom.appLE_map`). -/
   144	lemma Hom.baseSections_res_smul (p : X ⟶ S) (M : X.Modules) {W W' : X.Opens}
   145	    (h : W' ≤ W) (r : Γ(S, ⊤)) (m : Γ(M, W)) :
   146	    letI := p.baseSectionsModule M W
   147	    letI := p.baseSectionsModule M W'
   148	    M.presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op (r • m) =
   149	      r • M.presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op m := by
   150	  letI := p.baseSectionsModule M W
   151	  letI := p.baseSectionsModule M W'
   152	  rw [p.baseSectionsModule_smul_def M W r m, Scheme.Modules.map_smul,
   153	    p.baseSectionsModule_smul_def M W' r]
   154	  congr 1
   155	  have h1 := congrArg (fun φ : Γ(S, ⊤) ⟶ Γ(X, W') => φ.hom r)
   156	    (p.appLE_map (le_top : W ≤ p ⁻¹ᵁ ⊤) (homOfLE h).op)
   157	  simp only [CommRingCat.hom_comp, RingHom.comp_apply] at h1
   158	  exact h1
   159	
   160	/-- **The bundled `Γ(S, ⊤)`-linear section restriction** of a module on the
   161	total space of the family `p : X ⟶ S`, for the `baseSectionsModule`
   162	structures.  (`restrictₗ` of `Picard/QuotScheme.lean` is the sibling over
   163	the section ring of the source open; this one is linear over the base.) -/
   164	noncomputable def Hom.baseSectionsRes (p : X ⟶ S) (M : X.Modules) {W W' : X.Opens}
   165	    (h : W' ≤ W) :
   166	    letI := p.baseSectionsModule M W
   167	    letI := p.baseSectionsModule M W'
   168	    Γ(M, W) →ₗ[Γ(S, ⊤)] Γ(M, W') :=
   169	  letI := p.baseSectionsModule M W
   170	  letI := p.baseSectionsModule M W'
   171	  { toFun := fun m => M.presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op m
   172	    map_add' := map_add _
   173	    map_smul' := fun r m => p.baseSections_res_smul M h r m }
   174	
   175	/-- The underlying function of `baseSectionsRes` is the presheaf restriction. -/

/-!
# Fibrewise truncated Euler indices for line bundles

For a morphism `f : X ⟶ S`, a point `s : S`, and a sheaf of modules `M` on
`X`, this file defines the degree-at-most-one Euler index of the restricted
module `M_s` over the residue field `kappa(s)`.  For a line bundle `L` on a
relative product, it also defines the signed difference

`chi(L_t) - chi(O_{(C x_S T)_t})`.

The definitions deliberately use the name *index*, not geometric degree.
`CategoryTheory.Sheaf.chi` is totalized: without finite-dimensional `H0` and
`H1`, `Module.finrank` can read an infinite-dimensional space as zero.  The
line-bundle difference becomes the usual fibre degree only after the relevant
cohomological finiteness and Riemann--Roch comparison are supplied.

This file proves invariance under isomorphism of the underlying modules by
using `Scheme.toModuleKSheafOfModulesFunctor` and the existing
`CategoryTheory.Sheaf.chi_congr`.  It does not yet descend the difference
through the relative Picard or etale equivalence relation, prove pullback
naturality in the test scheme, or prove local constancy on that test scheme.

## Main declarations

* `Scheme.Hom.fiberEulerIndex`: the totalized truncated Euler index of a module
  on a scheme-theoretic fibre.
* `Scheme.LineBundle.OnProduct.fiberEulerIndexDifference`: the signed
  line-bundle index relative to the literal structure sheaf of the fibre.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

universe u

open CategoryTheory Limits

namespace AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme

variable {X S : Scheme.{u}}

/-- The totalized degree-at-most-one Euler index of the restriction of `M` to
the scheme-theoretic fibre of `f` at `s`, computed over `s`'s residue field.

No properness, dimension, or cohomological finiteness hypothesis is imposed,
so this is not asserted to be the genuine Euler characteristic. -/
noncomputable def Hom.fiberEulerIndex (f : X ⟶ S) (s : S)
    (M : X.Modules) : ℤ :=
  CategoryTheory.Sheaf.chi
    (toModuleKSheafOfModules
      (Over.mk (f.fiberToSpecResidueField s))
      (f.fiberModule s M))

/-- `fiberEulerIndex` is invariant under an isomorphism of modules on the
total space.  The isomorphism is pulled back to the fibre, restricted to the
residue field, and passed to `Sheaf.chi_congr`. -/
theorem Hom.fiberEulerIndex_congr (f : X ⟶ S) (s : S)
    {M N : X.Modules} (e : M ≅ N) :
    f.fiberEulerIndex s M = f.fiberEulerIndex s N :=
  chi_toModuleKSheafOfModules_congr
    (Over.mk (f.fiberToSpecResidueField s))
    ((Modules.pullback (f.fiberι s)).mapIso e)

namespace LineBundle.OnProduct

/-- The signed, normalized fibre index of a line bundle on `C x_k T`:
`chi(L_t) - chi(O_{(C x_k T)_t})`.

The second term uses the literal unit module on the fibre, rather than a
definitionally different pullback of the unit module on the total space.  This
is the cohomological expression that Riemann--Roch identifies with degree once
finiteness and the curve comparison are available.  At this stage it is only
a totalized truncated index and has not descended to the relative Picard
functor. -/
noncomputable def fiberEulerIndexDifference {k : Type u} [Field k]
    {C T : Scheme.{u}} (piC : C ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))
    (piT : T ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))
    (L : LineBundle.OnProduct piC piT) (t : T) : ℤ :=
  let q := pullback.snd piC piT
  q.fiberEulerIndex t L.carrier -
    CategoryTheory.Sheaf.chi
      (toModuleKSheafOfModules
        (Over.mk (q.fiberToSpecResidueField t))
        (SheafOfModules.unit (q.fiber t).ringCatSheaf))

/-- The normalized fibre index is invariant under an isomorphism of the
underlying line-bundle modules.  This is the iso-invariance needed before a
later descent to line-bundle isomorphism classes; it does not prove invariance
under tensoring by a bundle pulled back from `T`. -/
theorem fiberEulerIndexDifference_congr {k : Type u} [Field k]
    {C T : Scheme.{u}} (piC : C ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))
    (piT : T ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))
    {L L' : LineBundle.OnProduct piC piT}
    (e : L.carrier ≅ L'.carrier) (t : T) :
    fiberEulerIndexDifference piC piT L t =
      fiberEulerIndexDifference piC piT L' t := by
  dsimp [fiberEulerIndexDifference]
  rw [Hom.fiberEulerIndex_congr _ _ e]

end LineBundle.OnProduct

end AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme

+++ b/MainProjects/Algebraic-Jacobian-Challenge/AlgebraicJacobian/Picard/FiberEulerIndex.lean
@@ -3,7 +3,7 @@ Copyright (c) 2026 The AlgebraicJacobian authors. All rights reserved.
 Released under Apache 2.0 license as described in the file LICENSE.
 Authors: The AlgebraicJacobian Contributors
 -/
-import AlgebraicJacobian.Cohomology.StructureSheafModuleK.ModulesFunctor
+import AlgebraicJacobian.Cohomology.StructureSheafModuleK.EulerCechComparison
 import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.HilbertPolynomial
 import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.LineBundlePullback
 
@@ -33,6 +33,8 @@ naturality in the test scheme, or prove local constancy on that test scheme.
 
 * `Scheme.Hom.fiberEulerIndex`: the totalized truncated Euler index of a module
   on a scheme-theoretic fibre.
+* `Scheme.Hom.fiberEulerIndex_eq_cech`: computation of that index by any
+  two-affine cover of a quasicoherent fibre module.
 * `Scheme.LineBundle.OnProduct.fiberEulerIndexDifference`: the signed
   line-bundle index relative to the literal structure sheaf of the fibre.
 -/
@@ -59,6 +61,19 @@ noncomputable def Hom.fiberEulerIndex (f : X ⟶ S) (s : S)
       (Over.mk (f.fiberToSpecResidueField s))
       (f.fiberModule s M))
 
+/-- A two-affine cover of the fibre computes `fiberEulerIndex` for a
+quasicoherent module.  This is an equality with the concrete signed
+kernel/quotient-by-range index; it does not assert finite-dimensionality. -/
+theorem Hom.fiberEulerIndex_eq_cech (f : X ⟶ S) (s : S)
+    (M : X.Modules) [M.IsQuasicoherent]
+    (V : (f.fiber s).AffineCoverMVSquare) :
+    f.fiberEulerIndex s M =
+      V.chi (Over.mk (f.fiberToSpecResidueField s)) (f.fiberModule s M) := by
+  haveI : (f.fiberModule s M).IsQuasicoherent := f.fiberModule_isQuasicoherent s M
+  unfold Hom.fiberEulerIndex
+  exact @AffineCoverMVSquare.chi_toModuleKSheafOfModules_eq _ _
+    (Over.mk (f.fiberToSpecResidueField s)) V (f.fiberModule s M) this
+
 /-- `fiberEulerIndex` is invariant under an isomorphism of modules on the
 total space.  The isomorphism is pulled back to the fibre, restricted to the
 residue field, and passed to `Sheaf.chi_congr`. -/
